subject: Unauthorized High School Facility Use Moratorium
overview: The Committee recognized 35 Scholastic Writing Award winners and voted to partially reimburse families for a cancelled school trip. A moratorium was placed on batting cage rentals following reports of unauthorized use of high school facilities by an outside organization.

items.title: Minutes and Routine Approvals
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from February 1st and various bills and payrolls.

items.title: Boston Globe Scholastic Writing Awards
items.summary: The district recognized 35 student winners of the Scholastic Writing and Arts Awards, including five gold key recipients.

items.title: Cancelled School Trip Reimbursement
items.summary: Following public testimony regarding a trip to Washington D.C. cancelled for security reasons, the committee voted to reimburse families $115 each, representing 50% of the non-refundable insurance portion.

items.title: McGlynn Elementary School Gifts
items.summary: Approved a $600 anonymous donation for school events and a $300 Medford Arts Council grant for a cultural dance performance.

items.title: Professional Development Day Report
items.summary: Administrators outlined plans for a district-wide professional development day focused on inclusive teaching practices and computerized testing preparation.

items.title: Parent-Child Home Program
items.summary: The Superintendent reported on an evidence-based home visiting model currently serving 28 low-income families in the district.

items.title: St. Clements Elementary School Closing
items.summary: The committee discussed outreach strategies to encourage families affected by the closure of St. Clements to enroll in Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Chamber of Commerce Vocational Showcase
items.summary: The committee reviewed a recent partnership event at the vocational school intended to increase local student internships and co-op opportunities.

items.title: Financial Report
items.summary: Finance Director Patricia Velie reported that the budget is 65% expended and noted significant savings in heating costs due to warm weather.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences for the families of Robert Drennan, Gladys Maseka, and Nina Rexford.

items.title: Facility Use Moratorium and Audit
items.summary: The committee placed an immediate hold on batting cage rentals and requested a full audit of facility use after learning an outside organization was advertising the high school as its home base without authorization.
